l2d_voice#2.Text: 你终于注意到我了。 我刚才一直在跟你搭话呢……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_02_original_08_4f563df51b72
l2d_voice#2.Text: ……哇，好厉害！ 好多人都给了满分！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_03_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_042
l2d_voice#2.Text: 那个……你要把这块石头带回家吗？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_06_original_07_394b06ced79a
l2d_voice#2.Text: 咦，这个也不是海洋生物啊

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_07_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_041
l2d_voice#2.Text: （这个女孩，在找什么……嗯？在捡石头？）

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_original_02_4a20ea675efb
l2d_voice#2.Text: 你看，Tomorin。 有好多企鹅在游泳哦

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_original_04_4219bca7cd89
l2d_voice#2.Text: 等一下Rikki！ 事情还一点都没解决呢！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_10_original_05_d4e700c80ba3
l2d_voice#2.Text: 糟了，要被Rikki骂了！ 走吧，Tomorin！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_11_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_036
l2d_voice#2.Text: （面试感觉还不错～ 初中的综评也不错，入学应该不成问题）

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_12_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_055
l2d_voice#2.Text: （呼，虽然招呼打得只算中规中矩， 但要融入班级这样应该差不多够了）

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_15_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_049
l2d_voice#2.Text: 因为家庭原因在这个奇怪的时间入学， 希望大家愿意和我当朋友。 请多多关照！
